note: `codeExtractNative` compiles `keyframes()` and the `animation*` and `transition*` props for React Native on react-native-reanimated (part of #411): `keyframes()` becomes the keyframes object Reanimated reads, and an element taking an animation or a transition renders Reanimated's animated component. It takes a new `reanimated` argument telling whether the app has react-native-reanimated; without it, these are build errors asking to install it. Web output is unchanged.
